title: Unconfirmed note deletion silently closes the editor
reproduction: Open a note and confirm Delete.
Make the filtered soft-delete UPDATE return zero affected rows or a transport error.
Observe whether the editor remains open and reports the outcome.
expected: Only exactly one affected row confirms deletion. An error, unknown count, or zero rows keeps the editor open with a visible retry path.
actual: softDeleteNote returned true whenever Supabase reported no error, without checking affected rows. NoteEditor then navigated to the list; false and thrown failures had no visible notice.
severity: S3: a failed deletion is presented as completed
priority: P1: a note remains while the user believes it was deleted
verification_status: Source correction and deterministic guards authored; guarded red/green runs, compile, and native acceptance pending.

transition_history.reason: Independent Notes remaining-failure source audit identified the zero-row soft-delete branch.
Current source confirmed no affected-row check and no visible failure UI.
Sol assigned source and consumer guard repair after native artifact freeze.
